assumptions: The user supplies up to 12 bounded evidence records and is authorized to provide their excerpts.
Distinct URLs or threads are only a practical proxy for independent sources, not verified independent authors.

cases.description: Two synthetic independent forum records support a bounded, testable message hypothesis.

inputs.product_description: LedgerLeaf helps independent graphic designers organize bookkeeping and prepare records for tax time.
inputs.target_customer: Independent graphic designers in the United States.
inputs.research_focus: What makes bookkeeping difficult before tax time?
inputs.evidence_bundle: [{"evidence_id":"E-01","source_url":"https://forum.example.test/designers/receipt-thread","platform":"Designer forum","date":"2026-04-03","excerpt":"I spend hours chasing client receipts before tax time and still worry I missed some."},{"evidence_id":"E-02","source_url":"https://community.example.test/freelance/bookkeeping","platform":"Freelance community","date":"2026-05-11","excerpt":"Keeping receipts organized is the part of freelance bookkeeping I put off until year end."},{"evidence_id":"E-03","source_url":"https://reviews.example.test/tool/ledger","date":"2026-05-14","platform":"Software review site","excerpt":"I wish this had a calendar view."}]
